n05c2c85814f.s: Colonial officials watched drama troupes closely during the freedom movement mainly because a troupe could:
o: carry a political idea to thousands of illiterate people in one evening
reach only a few educated readers through printed scripts
stage plays only in English for urban elites
n05c2c85814f.x: Theatre could put a political idea before thousands of illiterate people in a single evening, which made drama companies an influential medium of nationalist mobilisation.

nf936cc43119.s: Drama companies became effective vehicles of reform and nationalist messages mainly because they were:
o: the main form of mass entertainment of the time
the main medium of printed propaganda
nf936cc43119.x: Drama companies were the main mass entertainment of the time, and this wide reach let them carry reformist and nationalist messages to the public.

n3c3eebd6a13.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
n3c3eebd6a13.x: Varavikrayam, like Kanyasulkam, is a social drama; the Surabhi repertoire and Gayopakhyanam belong to Padya natakam.

na12256225f9.s: At Kakinada in April 1921, Durgabai Deshmukh translated Gandhi's speech and arranged his meeting with:
na12256225f9.x: During Gandhi's visit to Kakinada in April 1921, Durgabai arranged his meeting with Devadasis and Muslim women, translated his speech and donated Rs 5,000 she had collected.

nea1a1280a3b.s: As a Congress volunteer, Durgabai Deshmukh is remembered for stopping whom at the gate for not having a pass?
nea1a1280a3b.x: As a volunteer, Durgabai stopped Jawaharlal Nehru at the gate because he had no pass; accounts link it to the Vijayawada AICC (1921) or the Kakinada Congress (1923).

n2677a3814b8.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Chitturi Annapurna Devi – Salt Satyagraha in Madras city
Ravuri Alivelu Mangatayaramma – founding of Andhra Mahila Sabha
Ponaka Kanakamma – anti-zamindari struggle in Nellore
n2677a3814b8.x: Ponaka Kanakamma of Nellore led the anti-zamindari struggle and founded schools. The Madras city Salt Satyagraha and the Andhra Mahila Sabha were Durgabai Deshmukh's, and the pamphlets at 17 were Chitturi Annapurna Devi's.

nc6e72800caa.s: Gandhi's 1921 tour of coastal Andhra is significant mainly because it:
o: launched the Quit India Movement in coastal Andhra
led to the first Congress ministry in Andhra
drew women into the national struggle in Andhra
brought immediate abolition of zamindari in Andhra
nc6e72800caa.x: Gandhi's 1921 coastal tour (Kakinada, Rajahmundry, Eluru, Machilipatnam, Chirala, Nellore) played an important role in drawing Andhra women into the national movement.

nap-history-28-3.s: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
o: Bipin Chandra Pal toured Andhra during the Vandemataram Movement.
Bipin Chandra Pal stayed with Ramadasu Naidu at Machilipatnam.
Unnava Lakshminarayana visited Palnadu in July 1921 to study the Vandemataram Movement.
Gandhi visited Hyderabad on 9 March 1934 for Harijan uplift work.
nap-history-28-3.x: Unnava Lakshminarayana visited Palnadu in July 1921 to study the Forest Satyagraha, not the Vandemataram Movement.

n46359d04abd.s: Tanguturi Prakasam was born in 1872 at:
n46359d04abd.x: Tanguturi Prakasam was born on 23 August 1872 at Vinodarayunipalem, in present-day Prakasam district.

n04400b9b840.s: Swarajya, started by Tanguturi Prakasam in 1921, was a(n):
n04400b9b840.x: Prakasam's Swarajya (1921) was an English daily (APPSC 2011 key); Grama Swarajya was a separate weekly of his.

ne8a6e373b0a.s: In 1951, Tanguturi Prakasam left the Congress with N.G. Ranga and founded the:
ne8a6e373b0a.x: Prakasam and N.G. Ranga left the Congress in 1951 and founded the Kisan Mazdoor Praja Party, which was later associated with the Praja Socialist Party.

nfe5a97ff698.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
nfe5a97ff698.x: Desoddharaka was the title of Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao; Duvvuri Subbamma was known as Desabandhavi.

nap-history-26-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-history-26-4.x: Parvataneni Veerayya Chowdary was Andhra Sivaji. Prakasam was Andhra Kesari, Duggirala Gopalakrishnaiah Andhra Ratna and Nyapathi Subba Rao Andhra Bhishma.

n28fcb4be8d7.s: Who was the President of the Andhra Mahasabha during 1941–46?
n28fcb4be8d7.x: The APPSC Group 2 2019 key gives M. Suryanarayana as Andhra Mahasabha President (1941–46), when it had become the CPI's organisational front.

n8c5a0efb8aa.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Eka Movement under Madari Pasi became violent.
2. The Eka Movement remained under Congress control.
3. The Bardoli Satyagraha was a non-violent Congress campaign led by Patel.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n8c5a0efb8aa.x: The Eka Movement (1921–22) under Madari Pasi turned violent and stayed outside Congress control, whereas Bardoli was a disciplined non-violent Congress campaign led by Patel.

n5cd18884ca6.s: The Prakasam Committee report (1938) concluded that land belonged to:
o: the zamindar, with the tiller only a tenant
the zamindar and the tenants jointly
the tiller, with the zamindar only a tax collector
n5cd18884ca6.x: The Prakasam Committee held that land belongs to the tiller and that the zamindar is merely a tax collector.

n8e715924355.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n8e715924355.x: Yakasiri Chellamma was associated with the women's chilli-powder resistance in the Nellore/Venkatagiri area.

n325e1e5a466.s: Ponaka Kanakamma led the anti-zamindari struggle in which area?
n325e1e5a466.x: Ponaka Kanakamma (APPSC G2 2008 key) led the Nellore/Venkatagiri struggle alongside Vennelakanti Raghavaiah and Dodla Ramireddy; Kalipatnam was led by Bhupathiraju Lakshmi Narasimha Raju.

nc8650efb38f.s: In which year did the Madras Congress Ministry under Rajaji appoint a committee on the zamindari system?
nc8650efb38f.x: The committee was appointed in 1937, with C. Rajagopalachari as Chief Minister and Tanguturi Prakasam as Revenue Minister.

n3f2728e28c4.s: The anti-zamindari agitations in Andhra helped make the Madras Act of 1948:
o: the last zamindari abolition law of independent India
one of the first zamindari abolition laws of independent India
a law that restored zamindari rights
a law applicable only to princely states
n3f2728e28c4.x: The Andhra agitations created the political conditions in which the Madras Act of 1948 became one of the first zamindari abolition laws of independent India.

n1ac761f614e.s:
Consider the following persons:
1. Pulleti Shyamasundara Rao
2. Gouthu Latchanna
3. Gottipati Brahmaiah
Who among the above were Srikakulam kisan leaders?
n1ac761f614e.x: Pulleti Shyamasundara Rao and Gouthu Latchanna were Srikakulam kisan leaders; Gottipati Brahmaiah is linked with the zamindari ryot movement and the Munagala Award.

nadf52d46639.s: The Indian Forest Act of 1878 added to tribal discontent by treating forests as:
nadf52d46639.x: The 1878 Act made forests state property, strengthening state control and hurting tribal customary rights.

n892df480815.s: An important cause of the Santhal Hul was oppression by:
n892df480815.x: The Santhals rose against oppression by zamindars, moneylenders (the dikus) and the police.

nindian-history-129-11.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-129-11.x: The Indigo Revolt was in 1859–60; the Sanyasi-Fakir Rebellion was in the 18th century, the Paika Rebellion in 1817 and the Deccan Riots in 1875.

n8cb5411a987.s:
Consider the following statements about the Rampa rebellions:
1. The 1879–80 rebellion was led by local Agency leaders such as Chandrayya and Ambul Reddy.
2. The 1922–24 rebellion was led by Alluri Sitarama Raju.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
n8cb5411a987.x: The 1879–80 rebellion was led by local figures including Chandrayya, Tammanna Dora, Pulikantha Sambaiah and Ambul Reddy; Alluri Sitarama Raju led the later 1922–24 rebellion.

nindian-history-136-18.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Pabna Agrarian Movement was associated with peasants.
2. The Deccan Riots were associated with indigo cultivators.
3. The Rampa Rebellion was associated with Alluri Sitarama Raju.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-history-136-18.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The Deccan Riots were by peasants against moneylenders; indigo cultivators belong to the Indigo Revolt.

n57ed5020687.s: After the Santhal Hul, the British:
o: enacted the Chotanagpur Tenancy Act in 1876
made Santhal Parganas a separate district with laws protecting tribal land
placed Kolhan under the Munda-Manki system
transferred the Santhal areas to Assam
n57ed5020687.x: After the Hul, Santhal Parganas was created as a separate district with special laws to protect tribal land; the Chotanagpur Tenancy Act came later, in 1908.

na654318cb84.s: The Chotanagpur Tenancy Act, 1908 is significant because it:
o: barred transfer of tribal land to non-tribals and recognised Khuntkatti rights
introduced the Permanent Settlement in Chotanagpur
na654318cb84.x: The 1908 Act, a consequence of the Ulgulan, barred transfer of tribal land to non-tribals and recognised Khuntkatti rights.

n5f6211f76f4.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Telangana People's Struggle and its Lessons – K. Lingaraju
n5f6211f76f4.x: Telangana People's Struggle and its Lessons is by P. Sundarayya, not K. Lingaraju, who rendered Gorky's Mother into Telugu.

n974a128b338.s: The first political summer school was held in the summer of 1937 at:
n974a128b338.x: Kothapatnam in Guntur district hosted the first political summer school in 1937.

na7747c33461.s: Navasakti, the first Telugu communist paper, was edited by:
na7747c33461.x: Navasakti, the first Telugu communist paper, was published from Rajahmundry on 15 December 1937 with Chandra Rajeswara Rao as editor.

nac7daf5cf72.s: The memoir Veera Telangana Anubhavalu Gnapakalu was written by:
nac7daf5cf72.x: Veera Telangana Anubhavalu Gnapakalu is by Mallu Swarajyam (G2 2025); Veera Telangana (Na Anubhavalu) is by Ravi Narayana Reddy.

n5730cbf02a8.s: The term 'Scheduled Castes' was first used by the:
n5730cbf02a8.x: The term was first used by the Simon Commission, fixed by the Government of India Act, 1935, and the first list was issued in 1936.

n11c0b20ac9f.s: Section 63 of the Government of India Act, 1935 dealt with the Governor's:
n11c0b20ac9f.x: Section 63 enabled the Governor to address the provincial legislature in his discretion.

n5a3e1d7db3c.s: Dyarchy was criticised because ministers held transferred subjects while finance was a:
n5a3e1d7db3c.x: Ministers controlled transferred subjects, but finance remained a reserved subject, so they lacked financial control.

n92f8fff0dd4.s: Under the Government of India Act, 1919, the upper chamber of the bicameral central legislature was the:
n92f8fff0dd4.x: The 1919 Act created a bicameral central legislature with the Council of State as the upper chamber and the Legislative Assembly as the lower chamber.

n44f446e38c5.s: The Government of India Act, 1935, the longest British Act on India, contained:
n44f446e38c5.x: The Act contained 321 sections and 10 schedules; some references describe it as having 14 parts and 321 articles.

n60282ba14f6.s: Who was the first President of the Legislative Assembly under the 1919 Act?
n60282ba14f6.x: Frederick Whyte was the first President of the Legislative Assembly, with Sachchidananda Sinha as the first Deputy President.

n600b15f6f80.s: Which pair of anti-Simon Commission protest centre and leader is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Tenali and Guntur – G.V. Unnayya Sastri
n600b15f6f80.x: The Lucknow protest was led by Jawaharlal Nehru and G.B. Pant; G.V. Unnayya Sastri led the protests at Tenali and Guntur.

ne77836e852d.s: Which pair (feature of the 1935 Act – counterpart in the Constitution) is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Federal scheme and PSCs – Union-State structure and UPSC/State PSCs
ne77836e852d.x: The Instrument of Instructions corresponds to the Directive Principles of State Policy, not the Fundamental Rights.

ne5a586f38f7.s: The Simon Commission's neglect of Andhra's demand, with Prakasam's 'Andhra Kesari' moment, fuelled the demand for:
o: restoration of dyarchy in the provinces
ne5a586f38f7.x: The Simon Commission's neglect of Andhra's demand and Prakasam's role fuelled the demand for a separate Andhra Province.

nbbd77d01687.s: After returning from the Second Round Table Conference, Mahatma Gandhi:
o: attended the Third Round Table Conference
resumed the Civil Disobedience Movement and was jailed in Yerwada
nbbd77d01687.x: After the Second Conference, Gandhi resumed the Civil Disobedience Movement and was imprisoned in Yerwada; the Communal Award followed in August 1932.

n62d5c1a633d.s: In the 1937 Madras Congress ministry and legislature, which pair is correctly matched?
n62d5c1a633d.x: V.V. Giri held Labour and Industries; Prakasam held Revenue, Bezawada Gopala Reddy Local Self-Government, and Bulusu Sambamurthy was Speaker.

n36b0045ef92.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n36b0045ef92.x: The Lahore Resolution was in 1940; the Nehru Report belongs to 1928–29, Iqbal's Allahabad Address to 1930 and Rahmat Ali's Now or Never to 1933.

n0b962ca359a.s: Who advised Gandhi, on his return in 1915, to spend a year observing India before starting any movement?
n0b962ca359a.x: His political guru Gopal Krishna Gokhale advised him to spend a year observing India first.

nindian-history-100-19.s: Gandhi trained as a barrister in London at the:
nindian-history-100-19.x: Gandhi trained as a barrister at the Inner Temple in London.

nindian-history-100-21.s: Which of the following statements about Indian Opinion is INCORRECT?
o: It was Gandhi's paper in South Africa.
Its first issue appeared in June 1904.
It was printed in English, Gujarati, Hindi and Tamil.
Mansukhlal Hiralal Nazar was its first editor.
nindian-history-100-21.x: Indian Opinion first appeared in June 1903, not June 1904.

neea175ae1eb.s: The five Jain vows that influenced Gandhian thought are:
o: ahimsa, satya, asteya, aparigraha and swadeshi
ahimsa, satya, dana, tapas and brahmacharya
satya, ahimsa, swaraj, sarvodaya and aparigraha
ahimsa, satya, asteya, aparigraha and brahmacharya
neea175ae1eb.x: The five vows are ahimsa, satya, asteya, aparigraha and brahmacharya; the first four are linked with Parshvanatha and brahmacharya was added by Mahavira.

nindian-history-8-4.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Gandhi started Indian Opinion in South Africa in 1903.
2. Mansukhlal Hiralal Nazar was the first editor of Indian Opinion.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-history-8-4.x: Both are correct: Gandhi started Indian Opinion in South Africa in 1903, and Mansukhlal Hiralal Nazar was its first editor.

nindian-history-109-14.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Comrade – Jawaharlal Nehru and Rafi Ahmed Kidwai
nindian-history-109-14.x: Mook Nayak was Ambedkar's paper; Young India was Gandhi's, Comrade Muhammad Ali's, and Qaumi Awaz was linked with Nehru and Rafi Ahmed Kidwai.

nf2e7d5fd209.s:
Arrange in chronological order of establishment:
A. Sevagram
B. Phoenix Settlement
C. Sabarmati Ashram
D. Tolstoy Farm
nf2e7d5fd209.x: Phoenix Settlement (1904), Tolstoy Farm (1910), Sabarmati Ashram (1917) and Sevagram (1936).

n9e9ed0d04bf.s: Which Andhra leader worked at Gandhi's Sabarmati Satyagraha Ashram?
n9e9ed0d04bf.x: Potti Sriramulu worked at the Sabarmati Satyagraha Ashram.

nd34b288fa21.s: The Rowlatt Satyagraha of 1919 is significant as Gandhi's first:
nd34b288fa21.x: The Rowlatt Satyagraha (1919) was Gandhi's first all-India mass movement; Champaran was his first civil disobedience, Ahmedabad his first hunger strike and Kheda his first non-cooperation.

n3e118f9cf68.s: The socialism in the Indian Preamble is generally understood as a blend of:
o: Marxism and Gandhism, with a Marxist inclination
Marxism and Gandhism, with a Gandhian inclination
capitalism and Marxism, with a capitalist inclination
liberalism and Fabianism, with a liberal inclination
n3e118f9cf68.x: Indian socialism is described as combining Marxist and Gandhian elements while leaning towards Gandhian socialism.

n3d98d0b6ca7.s: Which place in Andhra Pradesh is noted for producing the finest khadi in India?
n3d98d0b6ca7.x: Ponduru in Srikakulam district is noted for the finest khadi in India; Guravareddypalem is linked with Prakasam's Khadi Development Centre.

nb973ef0404f.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nb973ef0404f.x: Phoenix Settlement was set up in 1904 near Durban; Tolstoy Farm in 1910 near Johannesburg.

nindian-history-100-24.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Gandhi's first major public speech in India – February 1916
nindian-history-100-24.x: Gandhi's BHU speech was in February 1916; he returned in January 1915, led Champaran in 1917 and the Ahmedabad Mill Strike in 1918.

n40bc4d14722.s: Which of the following pairs (person – protest after Jallianwala Bagh) is correctly matched?
o: Rabindranath Tagore – Returned the Kaiser-i-Hind medal
Mahatma Gandhi – Resigned from the Viceroy's Executive Council
C. Sankaran Nair – Renounced the Knighthood
C. Sankaran Nair – Resigned from the Viceroy's Executive Council
n40bc4d14722.x: C. Sankaran Nair resigned from the Viceroy's Executive Council; Tagore renounced his Knighthood and Gandhi returned the Kaiser-i-Hind medal.
